creator: lead

silhouette.evidence: Coastline reads clearly in ui_title.png: dark inked shoreline with pale foam band separates water from grass at a glance.

palette.evidence: Water teal-blue, olive grass and warm dry patches sit in one muted watercolour range in ui_title.png; play2.png ground stays grey-green without clashing.

readability.evidence: Creatures and props remain legible over the terrain in both captures, but the grey rocky biome in play2.png is low contrast against the hare.

cohesion.evidence: Paper-like mottled texture matches the inked creature outlines and parchment UI panels in ui_title.png.

distinctiveness.evidence: Hand-inked coast with foam and mottling gives an own look in ui_title.png, though biome variety seen so far is only grass, water, rock.

technical.evidence: Smooth coast verified in ui_title.png; ui_new.png backdrop shows blocky pixelated water edge at a coarser data resolution, a known blemish.

notes: Approved as static shader asset only. Pixelation in ui_new.png backdrop must be fixed before any future re-approval of new biomes.
